newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Jan-Oct budget deficit up 20.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Jan-Oct budget deficit up 20.2 pct.

text.p: Portugal's budget deficit rose 20.2 percent to 436 billion escudos from January to October, compared with the same year-ago period, mainly due to the timing of a funds transfer, the finance ministry said.

It said in a monthly report that the increase in the deficit was mainly due to the timing of a large transfer of funds to the social security department, which took place earlier this year than in 1995.

Current receipts rose seven percent to 3,265.3 billion escudos from January to October, compared with the same year-ago period, mainly due to the impact of a 16.4-percent increase in indirect tax revenues, a 9.2-percent increase in income tax revenes and 38.2-percent rise in corporate tax revenues.
The budget deficit rose 73.4 billion escudos from January to October, compared with the same period last year, and transfers to state departments rose 202.9 billion escudos.
